name: Mishra
description: Mishra is Urza's younger brother, an artificer from Argive who became leader of the Fallaji and Urza's rival in the Brothers' War, and who was corrupted by Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: With Urza and their master Tocasia, Mishra found a powerstone at the Caves of Koilos that split into two halves, and each brother kept one.

bio.text: After a drunken fight with Urza's stone, Tocasia was killed and Mishra fled.

citations.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Overwhelming Remorse (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: The Suwwardi enslaved him and took his Weakstone, but when a mechanical dragon killed the Qadir, Mishra found he could control it and became the new Qadir's raki.

citations.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At the Kroog peace talks he seduced Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone, and when Urza reclaimed it and declared war, Mishra's forces destroyed Kroog.

citations.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kroog", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Mishra became leader of the Fallaji and was known as the Butcher of Kroog.

"Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Gix, burned by the Weakstone when he tried to kill him, decided to corrupt Mishra instead, and Mishra was turned over to Gix and compleated.

citations.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At Argoth Urza found Mishra to be a construct of flesh and Phyrexian metal and destroyed him with the Golgothian Sylex.

"Sylex Blast", section "Cause". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sylex Blast", section "Result". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: "Mishra", section "Death and afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra in the Great Desert, take his Weakstone and make him a rakiq.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji took his stone and made him a rakiq (slave)

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to appoint Mishra as tutor to his son, though Mishra stays rakiq.
timeline.quote: Hajar convinced the Qadir to appoint Mishra as a tutor to his son

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Qadir orders Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign.
timeline.quote: the Qadir ordered Hajar to have Mishra killed after his son's first war campaign

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A giant mechanical dragon rises from the sands and slays the Qadir and many others; Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: Mishra found he could directly control the dragon instead

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Qadir's son becomes the new Qadir and appoints Mishra his raki.
timeline.quote: appointed Mishra his raki

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Zegon, Mishra meets Ashnod, who shows him the Staff of Zegon, and he takes her as apprentice.
timeline.quote: enough to take her on as an apprentice

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.
timeline.quote: the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an "empire"

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra attacks Kroog, left undefended by Urza's absence.
timeline.quote: allowing Mishra to launch an all-out attack on its capital

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
timeline.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

citation.text: Mightstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As children, Tocasia takes the brothers to Koilos, where Mishra discovers the weakstone.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

citation.text: Weakstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia itself a casualty of war.
timeline.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war

citation.text: Strip Mine (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mishra is eventually defeated.
timeline.quote: By the time Mishra was defeated

citation.text: Battering Ram (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Almaazan songmages of Sumifa surrender to Mishra and offer their powers to the Fallaji Empire to avoid destruction.
timeline.quote: surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire in the war to avoid the destruction of their nation

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Ashnod to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting; civil war breaks out after the Fall of Sumifa.
timeline.quote: although civil war eventually broke out after the Fall of Sumifa

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
timeline.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two orphans from Argive, Urza and Mishra, are brought to Tocasia's school and spend years learning the secrets of the Thran.
timeline.quote: They live for many years at the school, learning the secrets of the Thran.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers fly Tocasia in the ornithopter, crash near the Caves of Koilos and find two powerstones; each craves both and they begin to mistrust each other.
timeline.quote: Urza takes the Mightstone , and Mishra the Weakstone .

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers' contest ends in an explosion that kills Tocasia and many others, and they split ways.
timeline.quote: Their confrontation ends in an explosion, that kills Tocasia and many others.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod enters Mishra's camp, gives him an artifact and they kiss.
timeline.quote: Ashnod gives him a powerful artifact she has created herself and admits to being attracted to power.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Korlis conference the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces with ornithopters; open conflict erupts; Ashnod kills Urza's patron, and Urza's Mightstone bests Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.
timeline.quote: Fleeing, Mishra curses Urza and his house.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
timeline.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War spreads across Yotia and the Great Desert, and Mishra is changed by his experience in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Mishra's experience in Phyrexia seems to have changed him.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp to negotiate for Zegon and becomes his apprentice and lover; Zegon submits to the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra, his interest piqued, studied the staff, and they agreed she would become his apprentice. They also became lovers.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir kills the Warlord of Kroog, and Ashnod weakens Urza's automaton to free the Qadir before the Fallaji flee.
timeline.quote: Ashnod used her Staff of Zegon to weaken it, forcing it to release the Qadir.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Korlisian army destroys the transmogrants, Ashnod retreats to Mishra's Fortress and is sent to Sarinth.
timeline.quote: the transmogrants were all destroyed, and Ashnod had to retreat.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran escapes in 57 AR without the Sylex, and Ashnod follows Mishra to Argoth.
timeline.quote: Ashnod decided to follow him there.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When their father falls ill, Urza and Mishra are sent to study at Tocasia's archaeological dig.
timeline.quote: he sent them away to his old friend, Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers find the powerstone sealing Phyrexia and break it in two while each grabs for it.
timeline.quote: they broke it in two

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers' rivalry over the halves causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
timeline.quote: the inadvertent death of Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra is captured by the Suwwardi and enslaved, and has the Weakstone taken from him.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to make Mishra a teacher for his son.
timeline.quote: Hajar convinced the Qadir

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises from the sands and rampages, killing the Qadir; Mishra and Hajar recover the Weakstone and Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: The Qadir was killed in the confusion.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir makes Mishra his Raki and uses the dragon engine to unify the Fallaji under the Suwwardi.
timeline.quote: appointed Mishra his Raki

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Double-crossings and sneak attacks between the brothers escalate into open war.
timeline.quote: soon resulting in open war

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Fall of Kroog, Urza's avengers are outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Urza's avengers were completely outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
timeline.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra, having become the Brotherhood's puppet, is betrayed by them and turned over to Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra was betrayed by them and turned over to Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Last Battle at Argoth the brothers meet at the head of their armies and Urza finds Mishra corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered there that Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers destroy the college and many of its sages.
timeline.quote: the school itself was destroyed by the Brothers at some point during the war

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sardian dwarves, found to be trading with Mishra too, rise against Argive and are slaughtered.
timeline.quote: they eventually rose against Argive, and for this, they were slaughtered

citation.text: "Dwarf", section "Sardian Dwarves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After their parents' deaths, the brothers Urza and Mishra come to an archeological school, where their tale begins.
timeline.quote: Following the deaths of their parents, the two brothers came to one of the archeological schools.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Introduction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the contest between the brothers Tocasia is killed and her school is probably destroyed; each keeps one stone.
timeline.quote: As a result of the contest, Tocasia was killed and her school was most likely destroyed.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra confederates various Fallaji tribes under his central control.
timeline.quote: Over time, Mishra was able to confederate various tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trading conference at Korliss ends in an attack that provokes the brothers' struggle into open conflict.
timeline.quote: It provoked the brothers' struggle into open conflict.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra journeys to Phyrexia and returns changed, darker and more dangerous.
timeline.quote: Whatever the interpretation, it is plain that Mishra's character changes drastically at this point, becoming darker and more dangerous.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod cross into Phyrexia through a gate the Weakstone opened in the cave of Koilos.
timeline.quote: we are told earlier that Mishra and Ashnod crossed over into the world of Phyrexia through a gate that the Weakstone opened for them in the cave of Koilos

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra builds his stronghold on the foundation of the School of Tocasia in the Kher Ridges.
timeline.quote: Mishra's stronghold was found in the Kher Ridges -- built on the foundation of the School of Tocasia.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers struggle together against a Phyrexian demon, the black heart, in the desert.
timeline.quote: it is believed that the brothers struggled with a Phyrexian demon that might have entered Terisiare through the gateway in the cave of Koilos

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Hajar to besiege Terisia City, and after months the Brotherhood of Gix betrays the Third Path, leading to the city's fall.
timeline.quote: the Brotherhood of Gix betrayed the Third Path to Mishra, leading to the Fall of Terisia City .

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix manipulates both brothers, fails to kill Mishra because of the Weakstone, and oversees Mishra's Compleation.
timeline.quote: he oversaw Mishra's Compleation, bringing the younger brother fully into Phyrexia's grasp

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, starting the Battle at Argoth.
timeline.quote: He also lured both brothers to Argoth

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with his army and dragon engines and destroys Kroog; Kayla flees pregnant with Harbin.
timeline.quote: In one morning, Kroog was destroyed

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra uncover the stones in the Hall of Tagsin, each taking one, which reactivates the gate to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza took the Mightstone and Mishra the Weakstone, unwittingly reactivating the gate to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The jealous brothers use the stones against each other and accidentally kill Tocasia, then separate.
timeline.quote: accidentally killing Tocasia when she tried to calm them

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra is enslaved by the Fallaji, freed by Hajar, learns he can control a dragon engine, and begins the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Mishra found that he could control it .

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Mishra and the Weakstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weakstone protects Mishra from Gix, who decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: Gix then decided to corrupt Mishra instead.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Mishra and the Weakstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza finds Kayla with Mishra, negotiations collapse and war is declared; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra ascends as Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra would then ascend as Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Opposing sides of war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Urza are born; years later their father dies after sending them to apprentice with Tocasia.
timeline.quote: they remained with her

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tocasia, Urza and Mishra fly to the Thran city Koilos, find a great machine, and an explosion leaves each brother holding half of the powerstone.
timeline.quote: each brother was holding a half of the great stone in their hand

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra confronts Urza while drunk and tries to take his stone; Tocasia is killed caught between the stones' powers and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: she was caught between the powers surging from the two stones and died

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra, enslave him and take his Weakstone.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi, a militant faction of the Fallaji, who enslaved him

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hajar has Mishra set as tutor to the Qadir's son.
timeline.quote: Hajar convinced the Qadir

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises and slays the Qadir; Mishra retrieves the Weakstone and discovers he can control the dragon.
timeline.quote: Mishra found he could directly control it instead

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir promotes Mishra to raki and they set out to unify the Fallaji; Mishra meets Ashnod.
timeline.quote: promoted Mishra from rakiq to raki

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra seduces Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone at the Kroog peace talks; Urza reclaims it and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Urza away hunting him, Mishra attacks Kroog; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra becomes leader of the Fallaji and the Butcher of Kroog.
timeline.quote: Ashnod killed the Qadir, leading to Mishra succeeding him as leader of the Fallaji

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 36 AR Gix is summoned to Mishra's Fortress, is burned by the Weakstone and decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: seeking instead to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix becomes Mishra's council, banishes Ashnod and helps take Terisia City.
timeline.quote: they became Mishra's council

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra, weakened by lung disease, listens to the Brotherhood's body-modification practices and dismisses Hajar.
